newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 30.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Wednesday:
* New York state lawmakers announced a tentative agreement on a budget of nearly $68 billion.
* New York State's budget pact contains some ambitious schools programs that represent the largest investment in education that New York has ever made.
* Yah Lin Trie, a friend of President Clinton who is suspected of donating foreign money to the Democratic Party, received $1.4 million in wire transfers from abroad from 1994 through 1996.
* The the glow of the Federal budget accord, Democrats and Republicans were seen taking credit for each other's ideas.

* President Clinton and Republicans separately celebrated their long-sought agreement on a plan to balance the Federal budget after decades of defecit spending and to provide the first Federal tax cut in 16 years.
* The productive and competitive edge that created the German economic miracle has eroded, leaving a sense that the good times are over.
